ranked_facts.why: Bilateral inferior lens dislocation is a characteristic feature of Marfan syndrome and homocystinuria, which are part of the Genetic Disorder with Marfanoid Features branch, but it is not typically seen in Connective Tissue Disorder, Multisystem Developmental Disorder, or Other branches.

Long slender fingers are a common feature of Marfan syndrome and other Genetic Disorders with Marfanoid Features, but they are not typically seen in Multisystem Developmental Disorder or Other branches, and their presence in Connective Tissue Disorder is less specific.
